description.value:
Cast the action the first Ember's activation would cost

Frequency once per encounter

Activate two Embers you are carrying with a single action instead of one. The first resolves normally. The second resolves as though your Ash-Light were in it, even though it is not. When both have resolved, your Ash-Light is in the second Ember — the light followed the second call, and getting it back where you want it costs an action as usual.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ashcantor's entire signature resource system (Passage, a Passing, Walking Through, Embers, Ash-Light) has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- the class card itself (classes.ashcantor.json) ships system.rules: [], and no abilities/ or class-features/ card exists to hold a Passage/Ember mechanic either. Checked pf2e's own generic SpecialResource rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts:24-247) as a possible fit: every real user (Alchemist's Versatile Vials, Gunslinger's Munitions Machinist, Fumbus's iconic feats) is a daily-refilling consumable counter, never a one-way permanent-increase track like Passage -- no real class resource matches Passage's shape, so there is no base mechanic here to extend or modify. Specifically, "activate an Ember" has no rule-element representation -- Embers are flavor objects with no item/ability card modeling "activation" to double up on.
